operating_notes.text: Installed and operational 4500/5100T Intelligent Open Die Forging System at SMTC, Lucknow.
Aerolloy Technologies contributed ₹74.3 Cr of Q1FY27 total income (45.0%) with EBITDA of ₹33.4 Cr and PAT of ₹22.1 Cr.
TRAC Precision Solutions (UK) contributed ₹71.4 Cr of Q1FY27 total income and ₹6.1 Cr of EBITDA.
The Airbus agreement covers development, qualification, industrialisation and future supply of titanium castings for the A320neo, A330neo and A350 programmes.
Raised ₹1,800 crore via QIP through the issuance of 854,700 equity shares at ₹21,060 per share.
Aerolloy Technologies received a second development order from Safran Aircraft Engines for critical titanium cast components for the LEAP engine programme.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹225.47 Cr (+84.9% YoY), net profit ₹59.91 Cr (+143.8% YoY).
PTC Industries filed its statement of deviation or variation under Regulation 32 showing no deviation in QIP fund utilization for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
PTC Industries reported FY26 consolidated total income of ₹643.3 Cr and net profit of ₹101.6 Cr, driven by aerospace and strategic-materials momentum.

PTC Industries reported Q1FY27 consolidated total income of ₹197.1 Cr (+83.0% YoY) with EBITDA margin of 27.5%, and disclosed an Airbus titanium castings agreement plus BrahMos, ARDE-DRDO and Gun Factory Kanpur orders.
On October 13, 2026, PTC Industries announced the successful completion of its QIP, raising ₹1,800 crore by issuing 854,700 shares at ₹21,060 each.

On October 14, 2026, PTC Industries announced that its subsidiary Aerolloy Technologies received a development order and signed an MoU with Safran Aircraft Engines for critical titanium castings for the LEAP engine programme.
